exposure: ART-ET screening tool components: body mass index
obstetric history (including history of cesarean without vaginal delivery)
ultrasound examination of the cervical canal (visibility and length)
cohort: The study included 239 patients undergoing single euploid blastocyst transfer procedures.
finding: The ART-ET screening tool, incorporating cervical position, visibility and length of cervical canal, and obstetric history, demonstrated high specificity (99.5%) and accuracy (93.7%) for predicting difficult embryo transfers.
